name: phil/rate-limit-bundle
description: Slow down abusive clients on Symfony controllers, routes and forms: declare a limit, and refused requests get a 429 answer with the standard RateLimit headers.

suggest.ext-intl: For the normalization of the identifiers of the user keys at native speed; symfony/string uses its polyfill without it
suggest.ext-mbstring: For the case folding of the identifiers of the user keys at native speed; symfony/string uses its polyfill without it
suggest.phil/ip-anonymizer: To count the ip keys by network, so that an IPv6 subscriber's /64 shares one key
suggest.psr/log: For the warning logged when a limiter in observation would have refused a request
suggest.symfony/form: To limit the submissions of forms by their name
suggest.symfony/lock: For the lock the limiters reserve under, so that two requests of one key never both pass a full limit
suggest.symfony/security-core: For the user and user_or_ip keys of the signed-in user
suggest.symfony/translation: For the refusal page and the form error in the request's language
suggest.twig/twig: For the HTML page of a refusal
